Arms angle down symmetrically, both sleeves cover the whole arms below shoulders, no visible paws or wrists, torso and sleeves continue naturally beyond the image bottom. Neck opening sits just beneath the existing jaw, no shoulder gaps, no added accessories, no headwear, no eyewear, no jewelry, no objects. Full bear on a fully transparent background. Square composition.

traits.name: Burgundy beret

Match the front-facing camera and tactile softly faceted 3D collectible style with soft warm studio lighting. Keep all edges and padding visible, no cropping. A rich burgundy wool BERET, broad and low, softly draped toward viewer-left, small top nub, narrow black leather fitted headband. Broad asymmetric crown, not a narrow human head hat. Overall silhouette width about 3 times height. Complete accessory only.

traits.name: Studio headphones
traits.prompt: Create a revised ISOLATED transparent headphones accessory for the exact bear reference, in the green leather and brushed silver style of the other reference. Crucial anatomy: this bear's ears are HIGH on top of a VERY WIDE head. The two headphone earcups should cover those round ears, not the forehead or cheeks. Design two compact upright round forest-green leather cups at the UPPER LEFT and UPPER RIGHT ends, with a SHORT silver hinge and a shallow flexible padded connecting band that DROOPS slightly DOWN between them to rest on the bear's crown. Silhouette is extremely WIDE and SHALLOW, about 3.4:1 overall width:height. NO tall human headphone arch, NO large empty oval hole. The top of each earcup is approximately level with the middle of the connecting band; the cups hang only slightly below the middle of that band. Imagine headphones specially made for a teddy bear with high ears. Clean straight-on front elevation, bilateral symmetry, small silver circular medallion on each cup, tactile green leather stitching, softly faceted 3D artwork matching Bobo. Output ONLY the headset, no bear, no skin/fur, no stand, no shadow outside object, no glow, no words. Genuine transparent background with crisp antialiased edges; all hardware connected and fully within frame. This must be one complete very shallow wide wearable accessory.
